title: AgentCommandResponse
description: Client-to-server Jarvis command response. Instructions are repository guidance; AgentStateChanges are verified ledger mutation hints for cache invalidation.

Error.description: Existing AgentError discriminated union representation, unchanged.

Instructions.description: Applicable instructions ordered from workspace to project root to deeper directories; empty for no applicable guidance.

AgentStateChanges.description: Affected project and agent identities after confirmed canonical Working-turn/assignment transitions. This metadata is retained even when the following tool operation fails; unrelated writes produce an empty array.

Path.description: Workspace-relative source path using '/' separators. No absolute paths.

Content.description: UTF-8 Markdown or a complete-file omission notice. Automatic delivery is bounded by the client; explicit hierarchy retrieval is paginated.
